subjects.label: This year's edition against last year's
subjects.description: How this year's entry compares with earlier entries of the same series: nothing new, a reskin, features removed, one good year then one bad, worse with every release, and asking for something the previous edition had; comparisons with other franchises belong in genre.

subjects.label: Shooting and the shot meter
subjects.description: Making shots: the shot meter and its green window, release timing, layups that will not fall and shot selection; movement, defence and the other on-court systems belong in gameplay.

subjects.label: MyCareer and the created player
subjects.description: The career mode: whether it loads or keeps crashing, whether it has a story this year, and the created player's overall rating and how to raise it; other modes and general progression belong elsewhere.

subjects.label: Realism and physics
subjects.description: Whether play on the court moves like real basketball: the physics, how players move and how fast the animations play, and outcomes that could not happen in a real game; how the players look belongs in graphics.

subjects.label: Real players, courts and roster updates
subjects.description: The real league content in the game: whether rosters are updated with current players, whether the real alternate courts are present, and how faithfully real players' faces are rendered; the licence itself belongs in licensing.

subjects.label: Kobe memes
subjects.description: Jokes and memes about Kobe Bryant, in the Chinese reviews especially, that say nothing about the game; other memes and copypasta belong in offtopic.
